# Security Checklist: Retention And Deletion Execution

**Purpose**: Validate security, privacy, audit, and deletion-truth requirement quality before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-06-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are owner/admin deletion permissions specified before any whole-meeting destructive action can be accepted? [Completeness, Spec US1/FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Is bounded deletion confirmation copy required and are universal erasure claims explicitly forbidden? [Clarity, Spec FR-002/SC-008]
- [x] CHK003 Are normal review, transcript, audio, share, download, export, and direct artifact routes required to block original content once deletion starts? [Coverage, Spec FR-003/FR-019]
- [x] CHK004 Are deletion request, lifecycle audit, and initial report persistence required before destructive action runs? [Completeness, Spec FR-005, Lifecycle Contract]
- [x] CHK005 Are forbidden data classes documented for reports, audit, logs, diagnostics, screenshots, and evidence: private content, object keys, signed URLs, credentials, bearer tokens, provider payloads, and local paths? [Completeness, Spec FR-021]
- [x] CHK006 Are MediaScribe, Langfuse, diagnostics, workflow/temp state, backups, exports, and post-egress copies represented as explicit dependency/limit states? [Coverage, Spec FR-015/FR-017]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK007 Are metadata-only audit requirements consistent with preserving proof after private content is purged? [Consistency, Spec FR-007/FR-022]
- [x] CHK008 Is local desktop purge proof limited to metadata acknowledgement or local-expiry reliance without uploading private local artifacts? [Consistency, Spec FR-011/FR-012]
- [x] CHK009 Are denied and unauthorized deletion/report responses specified as bounded so they do not reveal private meeting existence or content? [Consistency, Spec US1/FR-021]
- [x] CHK010 Are post-egress limits consistent with 017 share/download/export behavior and deletion truth copy? [Consistency, Spec FR-017, Plan Scope]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK011 Can audit-fail-closed behavior be objectively tested before destructive action? [Measurability, Spec SC-002/SC-007]
- [x] CHK012 Can no-secret/no-content evidence scans validate lifecycle APIs, reports, audit metadata, logs, and screenshots? [Measurability, Spec SC-009]
- [x] CHK013 Can dependency unknown/unsupported, backup pending, local purge pending, retryable failure, and terminal failure be distinguished in validation? [Measurability, Spec SC-004/SC-007]

## Notes

- Security checklist passes. The plan and contracts preserve bounded deletion truth and keep audit/report state metadata-only.
